results.reflection:
OBSERVATIONS
- Five mirrors, one person, and one chair are placed in the left part of the tray.
- The five mirrors are grouped closely together in the left part of the tray.
- The person and chair are placed near each other, separate from the mirror group but still within the left part of the tray.
CONCLUSION
The scene is composed entirely within the left part of the tray, with a repeated object type—mirrors—forming a distinct cluster, while two different object types—the person and chair—are placed together apart from that cluster. This creates a composition defined by repetition in one grouping and singularity in another, both contained in the same lateral area without extending elsewhere.

The composition centers on two distinct, evenly spaced markers within an unadorned field, where repetition of form is offset by color contrast and balanced spacing, creating a minimal arrangement defined by separation and symmetry rather than grouping or hierarchy.
